tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows marked anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit) with a normal MCV, suggesting normocytic anemia. Erythrocyte count is slightly elevated, possibly reflecting compensation or lab artifact. Platelet count is normal, but platelet distribution width is high, indicating increased variability in platelet size, which may suggest reactive changes. Further clinical correlation and investigation into the cause of anemia are recommended.
